lines: Your name, your photo, your theme. This is your account.
Tap your avatar on My Popkins, and Your account opens.
It shows your photo, your name, and the phone number you sign in with. That number is read-only, and never shown to other members.
Change your name or your photo, and choose Save changes.
A message says it was saved just now, and the new name shows wherever you appear.
Leave the name empty, and nothing is saved. The field says: enter a name so people know who you are.
Pick a theme: Match my device, Light or Dark. Popkin takes it at once, and remembers it on this device.
Sign out asks first. Stay signed in is where the focus starts.
Confirm, and the session ends on this device. The welcome screen opens.
On a phone or a desktop, the account keeps one readable column in the middle.
What no screen shows: a signed out session stops working at once, wherever a copy of it is.
Still to come: telling the others live when a name changes.
That is journey seventeen. Popkin is a free platform for pop-up communities.
